title: Mansion at the End
style: 128 BPM cinematic future bass into neon cyber pop, gated choir stabs, detuned supersaw layers, glitched vocal chops, punchy synth bass, sidechained pad swells, live drum kit, four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated snare fills, stereo delay throws, analog tape saturation, festival-sheen anthem build, bittersweet uplift, instrumental as the star with short sung hooks, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — soft pulse, string swell, room tone]
One seat at the desk
One light in the dark
I picked my tools with my own hands
No rented dream, no borrowed spark
Mansion at the end… mansion at the end…

[Verse 1]
Chased the giants — web and wire
Every promise, every fire
Tabs like cities, noise like rain
Till the noise became a chain

Wasn't stuck — I was choosing slow
What stays, what goes, what runs the show
Final Orchestra in the room
Cade Verel — hold the tune

[Pre-Chorus]
Capture the moment — don't myth it later
Write it in the rip — name every layer
Lesson for me, lesson for you
If the world needs the map — we'll teach that too

[Chorus]
Mansion at the end
Mansion at the end
Every hallway lit by a friend
Mansion at the end
Not a gate, not a wall, not a trend
Mansion at the end — mansion at the end

[Verse 2]
Process over posture — proof over pride
Don't need a hundred doors — need one that's mine
Terminal truth — server in the verse
Code in the culture — lessons in the work

Not a hypnotic scroll in the pocket
Old school soul — we build and clock it
Free for the climb — paid for the craft
This is the stack — first act, last laugh

[Pre-Chorus]
Capture the moment — don't myth it later
Write it in the rip — name every layer
Lesson for me, lesson for you
If the world needs the map — we'll teach that too

[Chorus]
Mansion at the end
Mansion at the end
Every hallway lit by a friend
Mansion at the end
Not a gate, not a wall, not a trend
Mansion at the end — mansion at the end

[Bridge — stripped, half-spoken]
If you're listening — you're in the loop
Human in the middle, machine in the troop
We don't erase the struggle — we file the fight
Tomorrow's bright — 'cause we logged tonight
Cade Verel — hold the take
Final Orchestra — same tune, no fake

[Final Chorus — lifted, choir wide]
Mansion at the end
Mansion at the end
Every hallway lit by a friend
Mansion at the end
Not a gate, not a wall, not a trend
Mansion at the end — mansion at the end

[Outro]
Capture the moment…
Name the layer…
336… hold…
Mansion at the end
See you in the hallway
See you in the light
